# Drafting Studio

> Drafting Studio is a US-focused 2D AutoCAD drafting studio. We produce
> permit-ready 2D drafting sets for engineering firms, contractors,
> architects and developers: MEP, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire
> protection and lighting, plus engineering calculations and reports.
> 2D AutoCAD drafting only. We do not do 3D modeling, Revit or BIM, and we
> do not stamp drawings; the engineer of record reviews and stamps.

- [Drafting Studio](https://draftingstudio.org/): Permit-ready 2D AutoCAD drafting for engineering firms and contractors.
- [Services](https://draftingstudio.org/services): Electrical design, mechanical design (HVAC and plumbing), fire protection, calculations and reports.
- [Electrical Design Services](https://draftingstudio.org/services/electrical-design): Power plans, panel schedules, single-line diagrams, lighting and photometrics, fire alarm system design.
- [Mechanical Design Services](https://draftingstudio.org/services/mechanical-design): HVAC design, plumbing design and coordinated mechanical sets.
- [Fire Protection Services](https://draftingstudio.org/services/fire-protection): Sprinkler layout plans, fire alarm system design and hydraulic reports.
- [Industries](https://draftingstudio.org/industries): Restaurants, retail, multifamily, healthcare, offices, franchise rollouts and more.
- [Projects](https://draftingstudio.org/projects): Representative drafting scopes we have delivered.
- [Blog](https://draftingstudio.org/blog): Guides on MEP drafting, permit sets, load calculations, HVAC, plumbing and fire protection.
- [Request a Quote](https://draftingstudio.org/request-quote): Fixed-price quotes within one business day.
- [Contact](https://draftingstudio.org/contact): info@draftingstudio.org, WhatsApp +92 303 0143281.

## Services in detail

- Electrical system design, site electrical plans, single-line diagrams, power upgrades, lighting design and photometric design.
- HVAC design, plumbing design and combined mechanical design sets.
- Sprinkler layout plans and fire alarm system design to NFPA 13 and NFPA 72.
- Electrical load calculations and HVAC heating and cooling load calculations.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The studio drafts to the client's CAD standard and current US codes (NEC, IMC, IPC, NFPA 13 and 72, IES).
- Every set is delivered as a layered DWG plus plotted PDF, QC-checked, with two free minor revisions.
- No published prices: every job is quoted individually.
